item.tib: sgrub thabs brgya dang brgyad pa
item.skt: sha taM aSh+Ta sA d+ha naM
item.coloph: lha mo sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po dI paM kA ra shrI dz+nyA na dang / lo tsA ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi paN+Di ta dA na shrI dang /bod kyi lo tsA ba blo gros grags pas bcos te gtan la phab pa'o
